video_title: Trade Reaction 👀 Wolves trade Randle to Nets, Claxton headed to Bulls | NBA on ESPN

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Minnesota Timberwolves trade Julius Randle to the Brooklyn Nets
quotes.excerpt: Minnesota makes a trade, they send Julius Randle to Brooklyn, Nic Claxton goes to Chicago.
quotes.quote: Minnesota makes a trade, they send Julius Randle to Brooklyn, Nic Claxton goes to Chicago. The 28th pick goes to the Nets and Minnesota gets the 33rd pick in the draft. This trade cannot be done because Chicago is taking back Claxton into cap space, so this will not be done until July 6th.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Timberwolves' roster flexibility and cap situation after the trade
quotes.excerpt: Minnesota basically hit the wall as far as with this roster here.
quotes.quote: Minnesota basically hit the wall as far as with this roster here. They lose in the second round to San Antonio. They were going to sign Io, that was your priority. You would have been over the luxury tax, over the first apron, and you basically would have been playing the minimum game to try to fill out your depth. Now you have the flexibility to sign Io.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Chicago Bulls' need for a center and cap space usage
quotes.excerpt: You got to remember you got to spend 90% of the salary cap by the first day.
quotes.quote: You got to remember you got to spend 90% of the salary cap by the first day of the regular season. They are roughly 14-15 million dollars below that threshold. They still have money to go out and burn. You fill a need, which is a center. In a 24-hour window, your frontcourt can look like Caleb Wilson, Matas Buzelis, and Nic Claxton.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Brooklyn Nets' potential cap space and trade options
quotes.excerpt: Brooklyn is going to be interesting. They can certainly go the cap space game first.
quotes.quote: Brooklyn is going to be interesting. They can certainly go the cap space game first and use 30-35 million dollars in cap space. And then act as an over-the-cap team and do the Claxton for Randle trade. You need a little bit more to send out in a deal to be able to do that. But that is certainly an option.
